exposure: ultrasound finding of average diameter of the gestational sac
ultrasound finding of width of residual uterine content
ultrasound finding of blood flow signal of residual uterine content
cohort: A total of 89 patients with previous cesarean section who experienced early pregnancy loss and retained uterine content after initial expulsion, and chose continued medical treatment, were analyzed.
finding: The width and blood flow signal of the residual uterine content after expulsion were independent predictors for complete miscarriage following medical treatment for early pregnancy loss.
